verdict.rationale: Data-residency choice is a fair question for a cloud password manager, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or data residency. Connect Servers run in your own infrastructure but only provide API access to items and vaults; they are not a residency choice, and community posts only lament the loss of local vaults.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
